content: Apple documents AVCaptureSession.startRunning as synchronous and blocking. TN2445 describes late-frame discarding and retained-buffer exhaustion; application-owned async queues still need explicit bounded admission. Preserve separate session and analysis queues. Sources: https://developer.apple.com/documentation/avfoundation/avcapturesession/startrunning() https://developer.apple.com/library/archive/technotes/tn2445/_index.html
